exitCondition: Every rule-duplication site of the eyebrow family and the four primitives composes its recipe; pill-interactive adopted on the four in-scope reinventions; stylelint/build/tests green and verify-fidelity clean. Hairline sites are declared conformant (already token-referencing — adopting the mixin there adds nothing); anything else found en route is filed outside this changeset.

change.summary: %eyebrow/%eyebrow-wide, %card-shell, %skeleton-bar (mixin), %truncating-flex-child stop re-typing values and compose the generated recipes; %eyebrow-wide collapses into %eyebrow (0.14em is the settled single value). Every consumer of these primitives updates transitively.

Hand-typed .eyebrow/.label/.section-label property blocks become @include eyebrow (via %eyebrow where the file already uses primitives). Letter-spacing overrides at 0.12em are REMOVED (the settlement is one value, 0.14em); layout-only properties (margin, display) stay local.

acceptance: no remaining hand-typed 'letter-spacing: 0.12em' on an eyebrow-family class
